summary: The admitted v70 bullwhip replay stops before its first screen because the module-level JavaScript whipattack() helper reads the u binding declared only inside use_whip(). C apply.c keeps the whipattack label inside use_whip(), where its u.ux/u.uy references use the game-global hero state. The source-owned fix is to read the hero state from the helper argument.

mismatch.message: Replay error: u is not defined

source.branch: When use_whip() reaches the monster-weapon disarm branch and the proficiency roll selects case 2, it places the weapon at the hero square. The JavaScript whipattack helper is outside use_whip lexical scope and must read that square through state.u.
callers: apply.c:doapply() dispatches the BULLWHIP arm to use_whip(); js/apply.js doapply() calls use_whip() at line 5015.

evidence: The current saved queue identifies the canonical v70 recording and manifest, with 484 recorded steps, 0 matched screens/RNG/cursors, and first mismatch kind stop: Replay error: u is not defined.

A fresh admitted scan on commit 2b7b9f55258da7c0e63e7f1abea40f5079e6d4d9 reproduces ReferenceError: u is not defined at whipattack (js/apply.js:963:87), called by use_whip (js/apply.js:912:16), then doapply command dispatch (js/cmd.js:3041:16, rhack at 5986:25). The retained diagnostic log is /tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-JU99JH/stdout.log.

js/apply.js use_whip() declares const u = state.u at line 789, but whipattack() is a separate module-level function at lines 923-1028. Its case-2 floor-placement branch references u.ux/u.uy at lines 963, 964 and 983, which cannot resolve that binding.

C apply.c use_whip() spans lines 2954-3271. Its whipattack label is inside that same function at lines 3128-3271, so case 2 can access global u. The source path is use_whip(obj) selected from apply.c:doapply() BULLWHIP arm at line 4266.
This is a JavaScript lexical-scope defect in the already wired source path; it does not depend on the session seed or the five-dose input sequence.
